note: Every offer in the plan (blueprint §8). Each is a PROPOSAL until the owner approves it (approved:false). An offer renders only when approved is true OR the build has PREVIEW=1 (staging), and only between starts and ends (America/Los_Angeles, inclusive). Pages also hide past-dated offers client-side ([data-ends]). Never write 'reg.', 'was', 'valued at' or 'free' inside a paid offer. Medical offers: never. square_id = this offer's OWN Square special-price item (no codes). Bookable offers (special, series, first-visit) without one never render in production (the build logs a warning); PREVIEW shows the card with "Needs its own Square item before it can be booked" and no Book button. Never link a special to the general booking page.
